newsitem.title: UK: United News buys business service companies.
newsitem.headline: United News buys business service companies.

text.p: United News & Media Plc said on Tuesday it had acquired three companies to add to its business services division for a total of around $300 million.
In a statement the company said it had acquired a Brazilian trade show organiser, Lemos Britto, Technology & Learning Magazine and a U.S. newswire, Southwest Newswire.
The company said the three businesses were expected to enhance earnings in 1997.
Lemos Britto and Technology & Learning Magazine have both been acquired by the group's Miller Freeman unit, a U.S.-based publisher and exhibition organiser.
Southwest Newswire, based in Dallas, Texas, has been acquired by PR Newswire, which distributes corporate and other news releases.
